subtitle: Tier 4 Final — 12 cumulative questions covering lessons 31-38. Pass with 10/12 to unlock Tier 5 (Macro & Context).

blocks.title: About this final
blocks.content:
Tier 4 was the advanced layer — order flow, Wyckoff, SMC concepts, multi-exchange divergence, funding sentiment. These build on top of everything from Tiers 1-3 and give you the institutional-perspective tools that separate sophisticated from basic retail trading.

Pass threshold: 10/12 required.

rows: Aggressive flow truth-teller. CVD divergence with price = strong reversal warning.
Retail stops cluster predictably. Don't be the prey; position FOR the hunt.
Accumulation → markup → distribution → markdown. Phase determines trade type.
Phase transition patterns. Exceptional R:R because SL is tight beyond wick.
Institutional zones. 3-step play: build OB → hunt liquidity → return to OB.
5 empirically-valuable concepts. Skip marketing fluff. Integrate with classical TA.
Cross-venue disagreement reveals isolated flow. Unique crypto edge.
Extreme funding = overcrowded positioning. Contrarian signal + cascade risk.

blocks.content: If you pass at 10/12, Tier 5 (Macro & Context) unlocks — DXY/VIX/S&P, BTC dominance, F&G, news events, correlation regimes.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.content: Tier 4 themes that show up across questions: institutional perspective (not retail), confluence-stacking with chart structure, positioning/sentiment as context, the difference between empirically-valuable concepts and marketing.
